moments.title: Bonfire Night Approaches
moments.blurb: Bonfire Night, commemorating the Gunpowder Plot, takes place this Thursday, November 5th, with many firework displays planned across the UK over the weekend.

angles.name: National Countdown
angles.copy: Guy Fawkes Night is just a few days away! Whether you're at an organised display or in the garden, stay safe and enjoy the spectacular.

angles.name: Local Displays
angles.copy: Wakefield, Pontefract and Castleford are all set for Bonfire Night celebrations! Check local listings for all the firework fun this week and weekend.

angles.name: Safety First
angles.copy: As Bonfire Night approaches, remember safety first! Keep pets indoors and follow firework code. Have a brilliant and safe evening.

moments.title: Remembrance Sunday
moments.blurb: The UK will observe Remembrance Sunday this coming Sunday, November 8th, with a national service at the Cenotaph in London and many local commemorations across the country.

angles.name: National Respect
angles.copy: This Sunday, we pause to remember. Remembrance Sunday on November 8th is a time to honour the service and sacrifice of our Armed Forces. Wear your poppy with pride. #LestWeForget

angles.name: London Cenotaph
angles.copy: The National Service of Remembrance at the Cenotaph in Whitehall takes place this Sunday. A solemn and important occasion for the capital and the nation.
